title: Collection-Date Assignment Redirects Answers in Temporal QA
abstract: arXiv:2610.32191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A collection date records when a source revision was acquired, not when its contents changed. Can assigning this metadata redirect temporal question answering despite unchanged evidence? Swapping the question day and following day between two revisions lowers later-reference exact match (EM) by 37.6-51.4 percentage points across five open-weight LLMs on 595 Wikipedia pages, replicated on 128 disjoint pages. Previous-day swaps retain 29.0-39.6-point losses on 497 pages. Seven prompt variants, including explicit ignore-collection instructions and archived-revision provenance, retain the effect. Fictional answers and English month-name question dates show that remembered answers and identical date strings are unnecessary. Matched thinking reduces Qwen3.5's penalty from 30.1 to 11.1 points, while native reasoners vary. Two API LLMs show small Wikipedia swap effects and rarely shift to earlier answers on fictional records. Large swap-induced

translated_title: 收集日期标注会重定向时间性问答中的答案
translated_abstract: 收集日期记录的是源文本修订版被获取的时间，而非其内容发生变化的时间。在证据内容不变的情况下，为文档标注这一元数据能否改变时间性问答的答案？在595个维基百科页面上，将问题日期与次日在两个修订版之间互换，使五个开源权重大语言模型在引用“后一日期”时的精确匹配率（EM）下降了37.6至51.4个百分点，并在128个互不重叠的页面上得到复现。改用前一日期的互换在497个页面上仍造成29.0至39.6个百分点的损失。包括明确要求忽略收集日期的指令和归档修订版来源信息在内的七种提示词变体，均无法消除该效应。虚构答案和以英文月份名称表示的问题日期表明，模型记住的答案和完全相同的日期字符串都不是产生该效应的必要条件。匹配的思考模式将Qwen3.5的损失从30.1个百分点降至11.1个百分点，而原生推理模型的表现则参差不齐。两个API大语言模型在维基百科互换实验中仅表现出较小的效应，且在虚构记录上很少转向更早的答案。大规模互换引起的（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该研究发现在证据内容完全不变的情况下，仅为文档标注不同的收集日期元数据就能让大语言模型在时间性问答中大幅转向以该日期为参照的答案（精确匹配率下降最高达51.4个百分点），且包括明确忽略指令在内的七种提示策略均无法消除这一效应。
en_tdlr: Merely assigning a different collection-date metadata to unchanged source revisions redirects LLMs' temporal question answering toward the assigned date, causing exact-match drops of up to 51.4 percentage points that persist across seven prompt variants.
